info.title: Firemark API
info.summary: Read a workspace's Firemark results with an API key.
info.description: Read-only access to one workspace's published results: its brands, their results and prompts documents, run logs, a prompt's stored answers, Digital PR figures and cited sources. Nothing in the API starts a run or changes a brand. Limits: 60 requests a minute per key and 300 across a workspace's keys; over them the answer is 429 with `Retry-After`. A key is made on the API keys page of the account menu and is included on every paid plan. Generated from the route schemas: do not edit by hand.

get.description: What changed for the brand that passed Firemark's rules, in one digest: the claims the change email sends (movement, rank, overtakes, an engine doubling or halving), gap changes, own-page labels and the latest sentiment counts, each with its sentence, and which runs are compared and how many days apart. `since` is the run id last seen (`run.id` of the previous answer); without it, the run the change email compared with last, else the run before the latest. With no newer run, `new_run` is false and `statement` says so. For a weekly check of a brand.

parameters.description: The brand's id, from `GET /brands`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The run id last seen: a published run of the brand. Default: the run the change email compared with last, else the published run before the latest.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: A prompt group's id, from `groups` on `GET /brands`. Reads that group's figures, built on read: never filter a whole-brand document instead.

parameters.name: branded
parameters.description: `off` (or `false`) leaves out the prompts that name the brand.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: One engine's gaps, pages and sentiment; the claims keep only that engine's doubling or halving.

get.description: Where the brand loses, ordered for action, as `order_line` states. `kind`: `missing` (a competitor named and the brand not; the default), `engine_split` (some engines name the brand, others do not), `unlinked` (the brand named without a link where a named competitor is linked) or `changes` (gaps opened or closed over the latest three runs). A gap is counted in engines and runs, never as a percentage. Pass each row's `line` on as it is, and do not re-rank the rows.

parameters.description: The brand's id, from `GET /brands`.

parameters.name: kind

error.description: A sentence for a person. It may be reworded: branch on `code`.

code.description: The contract: never renamed or removed, and its status does not change. Known codes: unauthorised, plan_required, rate_limited, too_many_failures, bad_run_id, no_brand, not_published, no_publication, document_missing, no_answers, no_group, group_empty, no_run, all_branded, bad_period, no_run_in_period, bad_site, no_site, not_stored, bad_parameter, no_competitor. A code not listed may be added later: treat it by its status.

ResultsDocument.title: Results document for one publication (v3)
ResultsDocument.description: Counts, history, ranks, competitors, sources, the answer grid, ranges and claim records.

owned.description: Additive (claims-5): the profiles and channels the brand listed when the run was counted. Present only when it lists any.

own_pages.description: The brand's own pages cited. Optional: absent when the run's cited pages are not known, which is never zero.

sentiment.description: The latest run's sentiment counts (claims-4): the brand's rating on the answers naming it, on the engines in the run's totals. Optional: only in documents published since it shipped (schema_version stays 4). A short engine has no entry in by_engine.

mention_order.description: The latest run's order of mention (claims-6): where the brand is first mentioned among the names each answer counts. Optional: only in documents published since it shipped (schema_version stays 4). by_engine has every engine of the run, a short one on its own base; overall, by_stage and competitors are over the engines in the run's totals. competitors has the covered ones at or over the floor of 10.

period.description: With a period (`range`, `from`, `to`): the period, resolved on the brand's published runs.

ResultsEnginePoint.description: An engine's count per run, with the Wilson 95% range on that run's base when the base is 20 or more.
